text:
incident-bot: P0 — fncall/backpressure alert in us-west-2: agent-proxy 5xx rate + queue depth rising > 10m. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/abc123 · paging oncall now

Sara: oncall — got it. seeing timeouts from router -> agent-proxy, and a ton of structured-output payloads.

Sara: quick health check: 50% increase in avg latency for requests that include function_call metadata, error rate ~12%.

Mike: joining. i'm looking at invocation histogram. concurrency for agent workers saturated on p3s.

Ali: probably the new chaining users are hitting bursty agent loops. we should gate fncalls and reduce structured output to stable tokens.

Sara: agreed. propose immediate mitigations: 1) enable circuit breaker to suppress agent/ tool invocations at the edge for us-west-2 2) tighten per-tenant fncall rate limit 3) cap structured_output length to 1k chars for now.

Jamie: +1. also put fallback to text-only responses for affected tenants. we can use feature-flag to flip quickly.

Sara: runbook link: https://runbook.internal/incidents/mitigate-fncall-spike — following steps 1.1, 1.3, 2.2

Sara: executing feature flag flip now: `rctl flags set disable_agent_invokes=true --env prod --region us-west-2 --reason "mitigate fncall surge"`

deploy-bot: deploy started: feature-flag-service v2.14 -> prod-us-west-2 by sara (triggered via rctl)

Mike: applying rate limit rule on API gateway for requests with content_type:function_call — limit 10r/s per tenant, burst 20.

Ali: patching router config to drop/short-circuit agent invoke header:```
PATCH /v1/router/config
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "agent_invoke_policy": "circuit_break",
  "circuit_params": { "error_threshold_pct": 5, "cooldown_s": 60 }
}
```

Sara: updating quota service for free-tier/standard to reduce fncall quota by 80% until further notice. `quotactl update --scope free,standard --resource fncall --multiplier 0.2`

Jamie: adding structured-output trim middleware at the edge. config snippet:```yaml
structured_output:
  enabled: true
  max_chars: 1024
  truncate_strategy: suffix
```

Mike: run some smoke checks: curl to /health/invoke-sanity for a tenant — returns 200, errors reduced on agent-proxy side.

Sara: metrics now: fncall 5xx down from 12% -> 3.1% in last 3 mins, queue depth trending down. latency for normal generation unaffected.

incident-bot: page escalated to eng-sre, paging timeline recorded.

Ali: initiated temporary traffic shaping via L7: redirect ~60% of function_call traffic to fallback text-only model pool. rule id: ts-4762.

Jamie: sending comms to account ops for customers with high fncall usage — suggest mitigation guidance and ETA.

Mike: leaving a short note for oncall rotation: if errors recur after unmute, revert throttle and roll canary of agent-proxy with extra workers.

Sara: customer impact assessment: approx 120 tenants saw degraded fncall behavior; 8 tenants exceed SLA for third-party agents. We've queued manual outreach for top 10.

Jamie: tagging internal ticket: INT-9243. adding links to logs + sample trace for the top offender.

Sara: will keep thread open for 30m to ensure stability. if stable, we'll remove the circuit and scale workers instead of leaving long-term.

Mike: i can pick up scaling in the next window — scheduling autoscale bump and a controlled canary after 45m.

deploy-bot: feature-flag-service deploy succeeded in prod-us-west-2 by sara — roll 5e2f9a.

Sara: mitigation verified, metrics stable for 18m. preparing postmortem stub.

Ali: thanks all — great coordination. keeping incident channel pinned for updates. :thumbsup:

Sara: closing page in 30 unless we see regression.

Mike: drafting brief customer note now, will post in #customer-success for review.

Jamie: follow-up actions: 1) postmortem 2) automation: auto-circuit when fncall queue > X 3) perf tuning agent-proxy kernel. added to backlog.
